title.narrative: Strengthening sub-national dialogue on Urban and Territorial Sustainable Development in Mozambique

description.narrative:
The objective of the proposed project is to promote the dialogue and foster coordination between Provinces and the National Government regarding sub-national urban planning. The resultant Outcome is the promotion of a common strategic vision on sustainable territorial planning at sub-national level, fostered through the capitalization of the Inhambane Province experience.
This project will constitute the Phase 2 of the project “Supporting an Integrated and Strategic Sustainable Territorial Development for Inhambane Province”, implemented under the funding of the Catalan Agency for Cooperation and Development (ACCD), in coordination with the Ministry of Land and Environment (MTA) and the Executive Council of Inhambane Province (CEPI). Here, the Spatial Structure of Inhambane province has been studied by UN-Habitat through the Matrix of Functions tool. The methodology helped identifying priority development areas of the Province (settlement clusters), priority development nodes providing important functions for rural communities, and priority development corridors, promoting connectivity throughout the Province and spatializing the development possibilities of the provincial territory in a simple, readable way for decision-makers and urban planners.
The present project stands as a subsequent phase of the mentioned project, to capitalize and mainstream the planning experience towards a broader urban planning and policy support at the provincial and national level. This project will capitalize the results of the first phase with the aim of raising the attention of the other provinces and contributing to create a cohesive strategic vision between them on the sub-national scale regarding urban and strategic planning for a more equitable and sustainable territory. This capitalization, that will occur in a moment in which the country is elaborating its National Urbanization Policy, will support the understanding of challenges and opportunities at the sub-national level and their mainstreaming into a national urban policy at three specific levels, as following.
Within the province (technical assistance): Consolidation of the Inhambane planning experience by providing more technical assistance to the Provincial Government, including key recommendations, to improve planning efforts and capacity for territorial development in Inhambane Province already strengthened through the Phase 1 project. This will coincide with the last phase of public consultations necessary for the approval of the Provincial Territorial Development Plan. UN-Habitat will facilitate the dialogue between the Province and the Ministry of Land and Environment through bilateral strategic meetings dealing with the design and implementation of the plan, including the necessary connection with and scale down of the National Plan of Territorial Development (PNDT); the technical assistance will allow to support the Government to include and mainstream MoF recommendations into their Territorial Development Provincial Plan and other related planning and strategic instruments.
Horizontally between all provinces (dissemination and knowledge exchange events): Knowledge exchange and capacity building on sub-national planning challenges and priorities among Mozambique’s provinces, with special focus on the horizontal coordination and urbanization sensitive social issues. The aim is to strengthened capacity of the Provincial Governments, through the experience exchange with Inhambane Province and the Matrix of Function methodology, to properly understanding the configuration of the provincial territories that contribute to a more equitative and sustainable development, contributing to reduce the territorial asymmetries and guaranteeing an increasingly equitable development of its population. This tool adapted perfectly to the planning needs of the province in the moment of elaboration of the Strategic Plan for Inhambane Province (2021-23) and of the Provincial Territorial Development Plan of Inhambane Province, allowing in a short space of time to have important indicators for decision making, and also involving different institutional levels in the strategic planning under the principles of (i) simplicity of data collection, (ii) comprehensiveness of the planning method for the government representatives at different levels, and (iii) inclusion and capacity building to capacity building in strategic regional spatial planning tools. Such kind of synergies and mechanisms should be fostered also within the other provinces, in order to create a more balanced capacity, within the national territory, to deal with the same challenges.
Vertically with the Central Government (contribution to the National Urbanization Policy): Capitalization of good practices at the sub-national level on urban and territorial planning with the aim to support the process of elaboration of the National Urbanization Policy.
